list.title: Ministries
list.subtitle: The ministries your company serves: the secretary, the link, the budget and the requests.

form.name: Ministry name
form.thresholdPercent: Alert threshold (% of the last top-up)
form.secretarySeesBalance: The secretary sees the budget balance (decision O2)

detail.rotateConfirm: Regenerate the link? The current one stops working immediately, and the secretary receives the new one by email.

secretary.explain: The outgoing account is suspended, not deleted. The new one inherits the ministry and its history, the link is regenerated and the old one stops working.
secretary.confirm: Change secretary? The current link will stop working.

budget.title: Budget
budget.thresholdHint: As an amount or as a percentage of the last top-up. Empty: no alerts.

adjust.title: Correct the balance
adjust.explain: A correction is recorded as a movement, with your name and the reason. Nothing is deleted.
adjust.confirm: Correct the balance by {amount}? It is recorded under your name.

recipients.title: Who receives the alerts
recipients.none: Nobody configured (decision O1): alerts are recorded and not sent.
recipients.name: Name

external.title: External payment
external.explain: The ministry pays outside the platform. Confirming records the payment, deducts it from the budget and releases issuance.
external.confirmConfirm: Confirm {amount}? It is deducted from the ministry's budget.
external.confirmedLine: Confirmed: {amount}, paid on {date} by {method}, confirmed by {by}
external.reverseConfirm: Reverse the payment? The balance is restored and issuance is blocked again.

admin.title: B2G
admin.subtitle: Every sale to government, from every partner. Read-only by default.
admin.noPartners: No partner sells to government yet.
admin.readOnly: Read-only. Intervening (correcting a balance) asks for confirmation and a reason, and is recorded.

wallet.subtitle: Each ministry's budget balance, for reference only.

errors.onlyManagers: Only an administrator manages ministries and budgets.
errors.onlyWeefly: Only a WeeFly admin corrects balances.
errors.slugShape: The identifier only takes lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
errors.slugTaken: A ministry with that identifier already exists.
errors.caseHasNoMinistry: This case does not belong to a ministry.
errors.alreadyConfirmed: This case's external payment has already been confirmed.
errors.insufficient: Insufficient balance: the ministry's budget does not cover this ticket. Nothing was recorded.
errors.nothingToReverse: There is no external payment to reverse.
errors.secretaryDenied: You cannot create the secretary's account for this partner.
errors.recipientChannel: Enter an email or a WhatsApp number.

notice.welcomeFailed: The welcome email did not go out: {reason}
notice.linkRotated: Link regenerated. The previous one no longer works.
notice.secretaryChanged: Secretary changed. The old link no longer works.
notice.externalConfirmed: External payment confirmed. Deducted from the budget; issuance is released.
notice.externalReversed: External payment reversed. The balance has been restored.
